patterns.note: A central vertical timeline acts as a primary navigation and content anchor, with content cards arranged in a two-column grid around it.
Hero text uses an extremely large, wide, and bold display font, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for body and metadata.
A distinctive palette of deep greens, light purples, and minty teals creates a vibrant yet structured feel.
The hero title and timeline elements remain fixed in the viewport while content scrolls underneath them, creating a layered parallax effect.
The background transitions from a gradient to a 3D blob illustration as the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Content is organized chronologically by date, with each date acting as a section header for a grid of curated links.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, fixed text overlay and a vertical timeline that remains in place while the main content scrolls beneath it.

The background employs a multi-layered approach, starting with a gradient that also remains fixed initially, then transitioning to a different, also fixed, 3D illustrative background as the scroll depth increases.
Content cards are presented in a responsive grid, appearing to slide up from below the sticky hero elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, wide, and bold hero text (~6x body) with large, bold section headings (~2x body) and clean, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for content cards and buttons, with subtle rounding for some UI elements and the site logo.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy hero section with large negative space, balanced spacing in the content grid, and airy vertical rhythm for the timeline.

standout: The site's distinctive design is defined by its fixed, oversized hero text and central timeline that overlays and reveals scrolling content. This creates a unique layered parallax effect, further enhanced by a vibrant, almost playful color palette and a dynamic background transition from a gradient to 3D blob illustrations.
